markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_First_Door
markers.note: Leads wherever you were expecting it to lead.

markers.name: INT_Mirror_of_Habits
markers.note: Shows how you have been playing. Not always flatteringly.

markers.name: INT_The_Path_That_Forms
markers.note: Ground appears one step ahead. Stop and it stops.

markers.name: INT_Room_of_Loud_Thinking
markers.note: Your proximity voice is broadcast to the whole reality while inside.

markers.name: INT_The_Contradiction
markers.note: A staircase going up and down at once. Both are true.

markers.name: INT_Certainty_Meter
markers.note: Measures how sure you are. Reacts to hesitation in your movement.

markers.name: INT_The_Agreeable_Wall
markers.note: Moves if two players push it. Refuses to move for one.

markers.name: INT_Memory_Pedestal
markers.note: Puts an artifact's origin story into the sky for everyone to read.

markers.name: INT_The_Quiet_Question
markers.note: Asks one thing. Remembers the answer across sessions.

markers.name: INT_Mind_Trip_Still
markers.note: Produces the Mind Trip potion. The world gets noticeably more honest.

markers.name: INT_The_Crowd
markers.note: Figures that copy whatever the most players are doing.
